bounds_table_entry.rationale: Controlled lab benchmark prototype Wilson 95% interval derived from n=60 prototype trials (k=22 successes, p_hat=0.3667). Method: hashcat_dictionary_rockyou_best64, Budget: 10000000, Horizon: 3600.0s. Outer rational bounds: [32/125, 247/500]. Notice: Classified as software benchmark prototype; quarantined from production ranking.

baseline_comparison.explanation: No reviewed expert judgment baseline exists for recover_asrep_secret in Week 3 releases. Week 3 reviewed release only covered 11 parameters for other techniques (e.g. reset_password); Week 4 AS-REP #228 declared recover_asrep_secret unrated with missing_basis_reasons: ['no_numeric_basis']. Direct numeric comparison against the reset_password interval [3/5, 19/20] is methodologically invalid due to distinct attack events, policies, and contexts. A narrower confidence interval does not imply superiority.
baseline_comparison.seamless_disposition: Preserve unrated fail-closed due to lack of observed password distribution and telemetry in BloodHound snapshot
